implementation_details.watch_selection: useEffect watches uiStore.selection changes with prevSelectionRef to detect actual changes
implementation_details.shot_selection: Switches dropdown to selection.sectionId, sets scrollToKey to selection.shotId when dataTableOpen
implementation_details.station_selection: Maps station_index to shot index (N-1 for N>=1, 0 for station 0), highlights and scrolls to that shot
implementation_details.section_selection: Switches dropdown, clears scrollToKey (no row highlight)
implementation_details.manual_dropdown: handleSectionChange always sets selection type to 'section' - no feedback loop issue since Select only fires onChange on user interaction
implementation_details.highlighted_shot_id: Computed via useMemo to derive correct shot ID from both shot and station selections
implementation_details.sync_gating: Only performs scroll/highlight work when dataTableOpen is true
implementation_details.performance: prevSelectionRef tracks previous selection to avoid triggering on sections data changes
implementation_details.scroll_cleanup: useEffect clears scrollToKey after 100ms to allow re-scrolling to same row

review_fixes.removed_isExternalSelectionRef: Not needed - Select doesn't call onChange on controlled value changes
review_fixes.added_highlightedShotId_memo: Derives shot ID for both shot and station selections
review_fixes.gated_scroll_on_dataTableOpen: Only scroll/highlight when table is open
review_fixes.added_prevSelectionRef: Tracks previous selection to avoid reacting to sections array changes
